title: Design System: SEED Malaysia Sales Dashboard

signal-orange.note: The only loud colour in the system. Capped at 10% of any screen. series-alan is an alias of this value.

status-ahead.note: At or above target; positive year-on-year movement.

status-watch.note: 90-99% of target. Collides with series-simon; separate by label or position, never hue alone.

status-behind.note: Under 90% of target, declines, and destructive actions.

status-info.note: Neutral emphasis and non-destructive controls. series-dino is an alias of this value.

series-khen.note: Series identity only. Sits close to Ahead Mint; never use it to imply performance.

series-seed.note: Series identity for the house account.

slate-bg.note: Default theme background. Surface hierarchy is built from tint alpha, not new hex values.

slate-ink.note: Default theme foreground. Its RGB triplet (226,232,240) is the --tint every border and muted text derives from.

crisp-bg.note: The strongest daylight theme. Every colour decision must be verified here as well as in Slate.

carbon-bg.note: Maximum-contrast theme for the worst lighting.

display.purpose: The dashboard title. One per page, never larger.

title.purpose: Card and section headings. The workhorse of the interface.

body.purpose: Supporting prose and descriptions. Cap at 65-75ch.

label.purpose: Uppercase micro-labels: KPI captions and table headers.

metric.purpose: Every comparable figure. Monospace so columns align and outliers are visible without reading.

shadows.name: dialog
shadows.purpose: File preview modal and dismissable panels.

shadows.name: gateway
shadows.purpose: The login card only. Never on a resting surface.

motion.name: state
motion.purpose: Default for hover, focus and activation on controls.

motion.name: meter
motion.purpose: Progress and achievement bars filling to a value.

motion.name: reduced
motion.purpose: Under prefers-reduced-motion, transitions resolve instantly. Never gate content visibility on a transition.

breakpoints.name: phone
breakpoints.purpose: The primary judging width. Every view is verified here first.

breakpoints.name: mobile-max
breakpoints.purpose: Below this: tabs become one scrolling row, grids collapse to a single column, tables scroll inside their own box.

breakpoints.name: narrow-max
breakpoints.purpose: Below this: the drill-down sidebar stacks above its content.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The single most likely next action in a view. One per screen.
components.css: .ds-stage { background:#0F172A; padding:20px; display:flex; gap:10px; flex-wrap:wrap; align-items:center; font-family:'Inter','DM Sans',system-ui,sans-serif; } .ds-btn-primary { background:#E8633B; color:#fff; border:none; border-radius:8px; padding:10px 22px; font-size:13px; font-weight:600; font-family:inherit; cursor:pointer; transition:all 0.2s; } .ds-btn-primary:hover:not(:disabled) { filter:brightness(1.08); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline:2px solid #E8633B; outline-offset:2px; } .ds-btn-primary:disabled { background:rgba(232,99,59,0.5); cursor:not-allowed; }

components.name: Ghost Action Button
components.description: Row-level actions. Colour is semantic: blue views, mint saves, orange updates, coral removes.
components.css: .ds-stage { background:#0F172A; padding:20px; display:flex; gap:6px; flex-wrap:wrap; font-family:'Inter','DM Sans',system-ui,sans-serif; } .ds-btn-ghost { background:transparent; border-radius:6px; padding:5px 10px; font-size:11px; font-weight:600; font-family:inherit; cursor:pointer; transition:all 0.2s; } .ds-btn-ghost:focus-visible { outline:2px solid currentColor; outline-offset:2px; } .ds-view { color:#3B82F6; border:1px solid rgba(59,130,246,0.33); } .ds-save { color:#34D399; border:1px solid rgba(52,211,153,0.33); } .ds-update { color:#E8633B; border:1px solid rgba(232,99,59,0.33); } .ds-remove { color:#F87171; border:1px solid rgba(248,113,113,0.33); } .ds-btn-ghost:hover { background:rgba(226,232,240,0.06); }

components.name: Navigation Tab
components.description: Primary navigation. Inactive carries a transparent border so the row never shifts on activation.
components.css: .ds-stage { background:#0F172A; padding:20px; display:flex; gap:4px; flex-wrap:wrap; font-family:'DM Sans',sans-serif; } .ds-tab { background:transparent; color:rgba(226,232,240,0.5); border:1px solid transparent; border-radius:8px; padding:8px 18px; font-size:13px; font-weight:400; letter-spacing:0.3px; font-family:inherit; cursor:pointer; transition:all 0.2s; } .ds-tab:hover { color:rgba(226,232,240,0.8); } .ds-tab:focus-visible { outline:2px solid #E8633B; outline-offset:2px; } .ds-tab-active { background:rgba(232,99,59,0.15); color:#E8633B; border:1px solid rgba(232,99,59,0.3); font-weight:600; }

components.name: Filter Pill
components.description: Year and scope filters. Monospaced, fully rounded, solid when active.
components.css: .ds-stage { background:#0F172A; padding:20px; display:flex; gap:6px; flex-wrap:wrap; } .ds-pill { background:rgba(226,232,240,0.05); color:rgba(226,232,240,0.5); border:none; border-radius:20px; padding:6px 16px; font-size:12px; font-weight:600; font-family:'Space Mono',monospace; cursor:pointer; transition:all 0.2s; } .ds-pill:hover { background:rgba(226,232,240,0.1); } .ds-pill:focus-visible { outline:2px solid #E8633B; outline-offset:2px; } .ds-pill-active { background:#E8633B; color:#fff; }

components.name: KPI Panel
components.description: The signature object. Uppercase label, monospaced value coloured by status, and a trend line whose glyph carries direction without colour.
components.html:
YTD vs Target
87%
RM 243K of RM 280K (Jan–Jul)
▼ 4.2% vs prev year
components.css: .ds-stage { background:#0F172A; padding:20px; font-family:'Inter','DM Sans',system-ui,sans-serif; } .ds-kpi { background:rgba(226,232,240,0.03); border:1px solid rgba(226,232,240,0.06); border-radius:12px; padding:20px 24px; min-width:180px; max-width:280px; } .ds-kpi-label { font-size:11px; text-transform:uppercase; letter-spacing:1.5px; color:rgba(226,232,240,0.4); margin-bottom:8px; font-family:'DM Sans',sans-serif; } .ds-kpi-value { font-size:28px; font-weight:700; font-family:'Space Mono',monospace; line-height:1.1; } .ds-kpi-sub { font-size:12px; color:rgba(226,232,240,0.5); margin-top:6px; } .ds-kpi-trend { font-size:12px; margin-top:6px; font-weight:600; } .ds-behind { color:#F87171; } .ds-ahead { color:#34D399; }

components.name: Card
components.description: Page furniture. Flat forever — separation comes from a 2% tint fill and a hairline border, never a shadow.
components.html:
Monthly Revenue vs Target
Flat at rest. A shadow here would mean the surface floats, which it does not.
components.css: .ds-stage { background:#0F172A; padding:20px; font-family:'Inter','DM Sans',system-ui,sans-serif; } .ds-card { background:rgba(226,232,240,0.02); border:1px solid rgba(226,232,240,0.06); border-radius:14px; padding:20px; color:#F1F5F9; } .ds-card-title { font-size:14px; font-weight:600; margin-bottom:8px; } .ds-card-body { font-size:13px; font-weight:450; line-height:1.6; color:rgba(226,232,240,0.6); }

components.name: Text Input
components.description: Search and credential fields. Focus replaces the removed outline with a visible border shift.
components.css: .ds-stage { background:#0F172A; padding:20px; font-family:'Inter','DM Sans',system-ui,sans-serif; } .ds-input { width:100%; box-sizing:border-box; background:rgba(226,232,240,0.04); border:1px solid rgba(226,232,240,0.1); color:#F1F5F9; border-radius:8px; padding:10px 14px; font-size:13px; font-family:inherit; outline:none; transition:all 0.2s; } .ds-input::placeholder { color:rgba(226,232,240,0.55); } .ds-input:hover { border-color:rgba(226,232,240,0.18); } .ds-input:focus { border-color:#E8633B; box-shadow:0 0 0 3px rgba(232,99,59,0.15); }

components.name: Status Badge
components.description: A state read at a glance: 15% tint of its own colour with that colour at full strength for the text. Never grey on a coloured field.
components.html: AheadWatchBehindAdmin
components.css: .ds-stage { background:#0F172A; padding:20px; display:flex; gap:8px; flex-wrap:wrap; font-family:'Inter','DM Sans',system-ui,sans-serif; } .ds-badge { display:inline-block; padding:3px 10px; border-radius:6px; font-size:11px; font-weight:600; white-space:nowrap; } .ds-b-ahead { background:rgba(52,211,153,0.15); color:#34D399; } .ds-b-watch { background:rgba(245,158,11,0.15); color:#F59E0B; } .ds-b-behind { background:rgba(248,113,113,0.15); color:#F87171; } .ds-b-admin { background:rgba(232,99,59,0.15); color:#E8633B; }

narrative.overview:
This is a monitoring panel, not a report. Its job is to stay quiet while the numbers behave and become impossible to ignore the moment one doesn't. Every visual decision follows from that: the surface is dim and even, figures are set in monospace so columns align and a drop is visible without reading, and exactly one loud colour exists on the whole system. When a screen looks calm, that is information.

The reader is a salesperson holding a phone between customer visits, possibly in direct Malaysian sun. They already know their business. The system therefore never explains, never congratulates, and never decorates — it reports. Density is welcome where it earns its place; ornament never is.

The system explicitly rejects two things named in PRODUCT.md. It is not a spreadsheet dump: every screen ranks and de-emphasises, because deciding what matters most is the entire value added over the source workbook. And it is not heavy corporate BI (Power BI, Tableau): no filter rails flanking the content, no chrome competing with the numbers, nothing that needs a training session before a rep can read their own figures.
keyCharacteristics: Flat, even surfaces built from hairline borders and 2-3% tint fills
Monospaced figures throughout; the numbers are the interface
One accent colour, used only where action is required
Five complete themes, dark and light, all first-class
Phone-first: judged at 375px before any desktop view

rules.name: The Signal Rule
rules.body: Signal Orange appears on no more than 10% of any screen, and only where the user can act or has acted. It is forbidden as decoration, as a heading colour, and as a chart fill for anything other than Alan's series.

rules.name: The Two-Palette Rule
rules.body: Series colours identify who; status colours report how it is going. They must never be legible as each other, and the two vocabularies are now fully disjoint — the series palette was rebuilt so no rep shares a status hue. Both are theme-aware (a dark set and a darkened light set). Any chart showing both identity and performance should still separate them by position, label, or shape as well as colour.

rules.name: The Daylight Rule
rules.body: The light themes are not a courtesy. Sunlight readability is a stated product requirement, so no colour decision ships until it has been checked in Crisp as well as Slate. A value that only resolves on a dark background is unfinished.

rules.name: The Monospace Figures Rule
rules.body: Every number a user might compare — currency, percentage, row count, date, size — is set in Space Mono. Digits then share a width, columns align without effort, and a shorter bar reads as a smaller number at a glance. Proportional digits in a data column are prohibited.

rules.name: The One Family Rule
rules.body: Inter carries headings, labels, buttons and body. Do not introduce a second sans; the contrast in this system comes from weight, size, and the mono/proportional split, not from a font pairing.

rules.name: The Floating Rule
rules.body: A shadow means 'this element is above the page and will go away.' Cards, KPI panels, tables and chart containers are page furniture; they are flat, forever. If a resting surface has a shadow, it is wrong.

dos: Do set every comparable figure in Space Mono (700 for values) so columns align and outliers are visible without reading.
Do keep Signal Orange (#E8633B) under 10% of any screen, and only where the user can act.

Do pair every colour-coded state with a non-colour cue — a ▲/▼ glyph, a label, a position — so meaning survives greyscale, sunlight, and colour-vision deficiency. WCAG 2.1 AA (SC 1.4.1) is the stated bar.
Do verify every change in Crisp as well as Slate. Sunlight readability is a product requirement, not a preference.
Do build surface hierarchy from the tint ramp (2% card, 3% KPI, 4-5% hover, 6% border) rather than from new hex values.
Do let tables scroll inside their own container on a phone. The page itself must never scroll sideways.
Do keep transitions at 150-250ms. Users are mid-task and should not wait for choreography.
donts: Don't produce a spreadsheet dump — walls of figures at uniform weight where the reader does the analysis. Rank, group, and de-emphasise on every screen.

Don't drift toward heavy corporate BI (Power BI, Tableau): filter rails flanking the content, chrome competing with the numbers, or anything requiring training before a rep can read their own figures.
Don't put a shadow on a resting surface. Shadows mean 'floating and dismissable' — tooltip, modal, login card. Nothing else.
Don't distinguish salespeople by colour alone in a chart. The palettes are disjoint and per-theme, but colour still needs a second channel — position, a direct label, or the year-line dash pattern.

Don't hardcode a bright status/series hex as foreground text or a chart fill. Route it through STATUS.* (charts) or var(--st-*) (CSS) so it picks up the light-theme variant; a raw dark-theme value fails contrast on Paper and Crisp.
Don't reintroduce a font the interface doesn't use, or inject font <link> tags from inside React. Fonts load once from index.html (Inter / DM Sans / Space Mono only).
Don't nest a card inside a card, or reach for a card when a plain section with a heading would do.
Don't introduce a second sans-serif family. Contrast comes from weight, size, and the mono/proportional split.
Don't add gradients, glass blurs, coloured left-edge stripes, or gradient text anywhere. This is an instrument face.
Don't celebrate. No badges, streaks, trophies or congratulation on a shortfall.
